steps.label: log in with the password and put a second login key
steps.run: install -d -m 700 /root/.replay && rm -f /root/.replay/key /root/.replay/key.pub && ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' -C '{user}@{laptop}' -f /root/.replay/key && SSHPASS='{secret:password}' sshpass -e ssh -b {src} -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o LogLevel=ERROR -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1 {user}@{target} 'umask 077; mkdir -p ~/.ssh; cat >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys' < /root/.replay/key.pub
